recipes.name: Cinnamon Apple Cake (Hanukkah Cake)
ingredients_raw: 2 large baking apples, peeled and chopped

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Coat an 8-inch springform pan with cooking spray.
Beat 1 ½ cups sugar, cream cheese, butter, and vanilla extract together in a bowl with an electric mixer until soft and creamy; beat in eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.

Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl. Combine ¼ cup sugar and cinnamon in a separate small bowl. Stir 2 tablespoons cinnamon-sugar into flour mixture; reserve remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture.
Stir flour mixture into cream cheese mixture until batter is smooth; stir in apples. Pour batter into the prepared pan. Sprinkle batter with reserved cinnamon-sugar mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven until cake slightly pulls away from edges of the pan, about 1 ¼ hours. Cool cake completely on a wire rack before removing from the pan and slicing.

raw_recipe.headline: Cinnamon Apple Cake (Hanukkah Cake)
raw_recipe.description: This cinnamon apple Hanukkah cake recipe is a moist cake made with cream cheese, studded with fresh apple chunks, and sprinkled with cinnamon sugar.

review.reviewBody:
The first time I ever tried baking a cake I tried this. Worked a treat, came out tasty and juicy, everyone was impressed and it dissapeard quickly. 

The sugar on the top did look like it started to burn a little even after around 50 mins so I took it out thinking it might not be ready yet inside, but it was fine, tasted great. I guess I need to just learn how to spot when it's ready.

I am now however amazed at how much sugar goes into cakes! are they all like this?? 

very tasty and easy to understand instructions.

nice one.

Been making this for 1000 years! Legit. Found the recipe in cooking light magazine maybe 25 years ago and we make 3 to 6 from thanksgiving on. That version used nonfat cream cheese and margarine if you can imagine. We converted to full fat pretty soon there after. Either way works. I like slicing the apples thinly but have also left in cubes. Again either work. Use a serrated knife or risk pulling apples out. We also stir in a little coarse sugar for the reserved topping. Gives a great crunch. Lastly as instructions state. Stir or fold in flour. Over mixing will give the cake a depression in the center. Bonus. Honey Crisps work well with this cake! Mazel tov!

This was great. I made it as written, but I only baked it for 50 min. I put a circle of parchment paper in the bottom of the springform pan (and buttered it) so I could slip it onto a cake stand, and that worked well.

Absolutely love this recipe! I am dairy-free so I used country crock avocado oil sticks in place of butter and tofutti cream cheese in place of the regular cream cheese and it worked great! Highly recommended!
Very good recipe. We enjoyed it. However, my gut told me to cook apples 1st with some of the measured sugar & cinnamon for an even tastier and moister cake! I will try and let you know.

This was AMAZING!!!! I made it with King Arthur Gluten Free Measure for Measure flour and it came out PERFECT. I was extra generous with the cinnamon (yum) and was pleased that the amount was perfect for the topping. We ALL loved it!!!
Fabulous! Made in a 9" springform pan and cut the baking time by 7 min.

Like the other reviewers i had to take one star away due to excessive sweetness. However, this is a very moist and delicious cake. I used my jumbo muffin pan in lieu of a cake pan (too lazy to look for it), and made sure that I kept I eye on the baking time and adjusted accordingly. Very nice way of using up my apples!

I make this all the time, but I add cranberries with the apples. I soak the apple/ cranberries mixture in whatever alcohol I have available like Rum, Vodka or Brandy . I cut the sugar to 1 and 1/4 cups because it is way too sweet. I use 8oz of the cream cheese.This is my family’s favorite.
Would have given 5 stars but it was too sweet 1st time I made. This time around I used between 3/4 cups sugar

Soon as i started reading the recipe i remember it being it made in my family for ages, except at the time there' wasn't cream cheese, it used to be done with ricotta cheese...so i did it like my aunts and gramma did, with 3 apples instead of 2...it came out wonderful!!!!!!!!! house smelling of cinnamom and sugar, great emomeries to a great cake !!!!!!!!

The only changes I made was instead of 6oz of cream cheese, I used the 8oz package and IT WAS SO DELICIOUS!!! Moist, sweet and now I have to contain myself not to eat this cake more than once daily! 😔
We love this! Random recipe dessert day! Wonderful!

Made this and everyone really enjoyed it. My only issue is that the recipe needs to be more specific as to the amount of apple to be added. "Two large baking apples" is rather subjective as is "chop". Baking is precise so the amount of apple to be added needs to be more specific. Is it 4 ounces, 6 ounces? And the size of the shop could be more defined; 1/4", 1/2", diced, minced. I cut them fairly small. Also, mine took much longer to cook, an extra 15-20 minutes. But it still turned out great. Will certainly make it again.
My first attemp I forgot to add the flour mixture. Lol back to store for more cream cheese. Second atrempt wonderful!
Made with gluten free flour. A big hit with neighbors! Gave as Christmas gifts. Will make again, many times. Moist and cinnamon-y/Apple-y delicious

My family and I loved this delicious cake! I made it exactly as stated. I only had a 10” pan to bake it in. The cake came out flatter than the shown picture. Very yummy I added whipped cream on the slices. I’ve made this several times and it always comes delicious.
Delicious!
I love this dense, moist, flavorful apple cake. It is almost a cheesecake. I have made it twice and plan to make it again, soon!
I made no changes. Made it exactly as is and my husband and guests loved it! Will definitely make it again.
